body:
My dear friend,

Today is the Harvest Supper! Everyone is coming: the neighbors, the travellers, and someone special from Bellhaven.

Come to the square this evening. We will give thanks for everything that has grown this season, and for you.
summary: The Harvest Supper! Come to the square and give thanks.
done: What a wonderful supper. Thank you for this season!

tasks.where: at the coop by your house
